notes:
# Orvio 0.11

- Smoother scrolling in Movies, Series and Live TV: posters and logos now use a large on-device image cache, so artwork appears faster and is not downloaded again, and the Live TV player no longer redraws itself twice a second.
- A–Z sorting works on large libraries: the list is sorted once in the background ("Sorting A–Z…") instead of appearing to do nothing. Leading quotes are ignored.
- Live TV shows only All, Favorites and Categories; the Categories chip opens the full list and shows the chosen category.
- The sort chip says "Newest" instead of "Recently added".
- New History category in Movies, Series and Live TV: everything you watched, most recent first.
- TV player: OK plays or pauses, left and right jump one minute, and the buttons beside play jump 30 seconds.
- Movie and series pages show the full description; the Read synopsis / More buttons are gone.
- TV: lists and rows no longer jump with every arrow press; they only scroll when the next item would leave the screen.
- TV: going back to a list returns to the item you came from instead of the nearest one (categories, channel list, poster grid, Home rows).
- Home shows Recently watched: every movie and series you started, not only those between 5% and 95%.
- Live TV programme bars and descriptions appear sooner: more channels are fetched at once, earlier, and kept for ten minutes.
- Catch-up on Live TV channels that offer it: open programme information and choose Catch-up to watch recorded programmes of the last days (refresh the playlist once to enable it).
- When an episode ends, the next one starts after a 10-second countdown (Play now / Cancel).
- Episodes without their own picture show the series artwork with the episode number.
- Settings > Playback: default audio language, default subtitles and playback speed; a speed you choose in the player is remembered.
- Settings > Downloads: default quality, storage used and Delete all downloads.
- TV settings use the same side menu as Live TV, Movies and Series.
- Bigger favourite heart on the phone series page.
- Profiles: up to six per device, each with its own avatar, favourites, history, recent channels and playback settings. "Who's watching?" appears at start when there is more than one. Kids profiles show only children's categories, and any profile can have a 4-digit PIN.

First installation is manual. Existing installations download this update over the air; Android still asks to install it.

Audio decoder binaries are unchanged from 0.05; corresponding sources and licenses are attached.
